Visakhapatnam is heavy-industry country. RINL's Vizag Steel Plant, Hindustan Shipyard, the port and its logistics chain, the petrochemical units, and the fast-growing pharma and SEZ belts around Atchutapuram and Duvvada all run large project sites that need solid, lockable site offices. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer that builds steel units for exactly this kind of work and handles the long-haul dispatch into Vizag from our Bangalore factory, roughly 1,000 km away. We are the maker, not a marketplace reseller — see the container office range we build in-house, and this page covers what Vizag buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Visakhapatnam

Steel, shipyard and port contractors use them as project offices, permit/safety rooms and supervisor cabins on large sites. Pharma and engineering units in the SEZ belts use them as admin and documentation cabins during construction and expansion. Port and logistics operators use them as gate and weighbridge offices. Builders across the city's industrial and infrastructure projects use them as construction site offices and security posts. The common requirement is a rugged unit that arrives finished and stands up to a demanding, coastal heavy-industry environment.

Visakhapatnam industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial belts:

  • Autonagar / Gajuwaka heavy-industry belt (530012; Gajuwaka 530026) — the dense engineering, fabrication and ancillary cluster around the steel and port economy.
  • Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (RINL) / Ukkunagaram belt (530031) — large project and contractor sites needing site offices and safety cabins.
  • Visakhapatnam SEZ (VSEZ), Duvvada (530046) — IT, electronics and export units; temporary offices during fit-out and expansion.
  • Atchutapuram APIIC / SEZ pharma belt (531011) — the pharma and process cluster south of the city, a steady source of project-office and admin-cabin demand.

We also serve the Gangavaram and main Visakhapatnam port areas and sites toward Anakapalle; share the exact location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Visakhapatnam
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, documentation cabin, admin room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, safety room + store

For demanding steel and port sites, we also build a heavy-duty cargo container office on a reinforced shell. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Vizag orders are usually customised for the site and the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for pharma and admin use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; extra corrosion protection for coastal and port-side positions; and ramps or external steps. For one-off requirements we can build a prefabricated container office made to order. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Visakhapatnam

We manufacture in Bangalore and dispatch to Vizag by road — a long haul of around 1,000 km that we handle regularly. A default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access; given the distance we confirm a realistic transit window at order stage. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. The same plant serves container offices we deliver to Hyderabad, the nearest live sibling route, so the line east is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT (DIPP56005) and GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales — useful on long-distance orders where coordination matters. We supply across South India, including the container office page for Chennai and container office builds from our Bangalore plant.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Visakhapatnam depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, corrosion protection for coastal sites, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Visakhapatnam?

Price depends on size, insulation, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out, plus the long-distance transport. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Visakhapatnam?

Vizag is roughly 1,000 km from our Bangalore factory, so it is a longer haul than our nearer South cities. We confirm a realistic transit window at order stage based on your site location and access, and dispatch once the unit is built.

Are the units suitable for steel-plant, shipyard and coastal sites?

Yes. We can build on a reinforced shell with extra corrosion protection and the insulation and fit-out your site needs. Tell us the conditions and intended use and we configure the unit accordingly.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your Visakhapatnam container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
